title: South Florida Weekend Guide: Free and Cheap First
igCaption:
Free block parties, a midnight train, and a soccer move to Miami.
Oct. 24 and Oct. 31, South Florida, $45 and up

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami, WSVN 7News, ESPN

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #MiamiWeekend #ThingsToDoMiami

scenes.text: Halloween lands on a Saturday in twenty twenty-six, and South Florida has free plans before the paid ones.

Start in Wynwood. HalloWyn returns to Wynwood Marketplace for its thirteenth consecutive year, from seven p.m. to three a.m. Admission is free. The open bar option is forty-five dollars from seven to ten.
scenes.caption: Start in Wynwood. HalloWyn returns to Wynwood Marketplace for its 13th consecutive year, from 7 p.m. to 3 a.m. Admission is free. The open bar option is $45 from 7 to 10.

scenes.text: Lincoln Road starts earlier. Kids can trick-or-treat around the pedestrian mall from five-thirty to seven-thirty. At eight p.m., the block party shifts into the adult part of the night. Admission stays free.
scenes.caption: Lincoln Road starts earlier. Kids can trick-or-treat around the pedestrian mall from 5:30 to 7:30. At 8 p.m., the block party shifts into the adult part of the night. Admission stays free.

scenes.text: The Apple Store on Lincoln Road has a different kind of line this week. WSVN reported people forming up ahead of the iPhone Duo release on Friday. Apple's new phone is a foldable model.
scenes.caption: The Apple Store on Lincoln Road has a different kind of line this week. WSVN reported people forming up ahead of the iPhone Duo release on Friday. Apple's new phone is a foldable model.

scenes.text: For the cheap live music pick, Churchill’s in Little Haiti has Necrodanse at nine p.m. Last Grasp, In a Darkened Room, and Blood Orchid play live. Tickets run eleven to twenty dollars. If you're there, open NEAR and see who else caught the set.

scenes.text: The travel pick is Brightline’s one-night Midnight Train after Halloween Horror Nights. It leaves Orlando at twelve-fifteen a.m. Sunday, October twenty-fifth, then stops in West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Fort Lauderdale, Aventura, and Miami.
scenes.caption: The travel pick is Brightline’s one-night Midnight Train after Halloween Horror Nights. It leaves Orlando at 12:15 a.m. Sunday, Oct. 25, then stops in West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Fort Lauderdale, Aventura, and Miami.

scenes.text: Miami also gets the USMNT's Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal away leg against Haiti.
scenes.caption: Miami also gets the USMNT's Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal away leg against Haiti.

scenes.text: Pick the free one, the $45 one, or the midnight train. And if your weekend plans mean passing the same faces all over South Florida, NEAR is the app that shows you who those almost-meetings actually were.
